scoring.normalised: raw / sum(weight of every question asked in the chosen branch)
scoring.note: Branches have different total weight (banking 12.2, tech_support 12.7, government_tax 10.2, delivery 9.5), so a raw score of +3 does not mean the same thing in each. Bands below apply to the NORMALISED score, which always runs -1.0 to +1.0.
